  "explanation": "The proof records only g(x)>-x and never establishes g(x)≥0 for arbitrary x. Equation (4) is iterated only at points already known to have positive difference. Thus §3’s restriction V⊆{0,c} does not follow, since negative values remain possible. One sentence suffices: induction from (3) gives f^n(x)=x+n g(x)>0 for every n≥0, which forces g(x)≥0."
